Through candid conversations with fascinating humans—from founders and artists to scientists and philosophers, and people who have chosen to live differently—we ask better questions about what it means to be human.

What does success mean to you now? What have you stopped believing? What makes you feel alive? What are you becoming?

At the intersection of ambition and humanity, science and mystery, technology and intuition, we explore how to pursue what matters without losing touch with ourselves—or each other.

There is room here for beauty. For pleasure. For reinvention. For the courage to become more completely yourself.

Because the goal isn’t to escape your life or endlessly optimize it.

It’s to actually inhabit it.

Welcome to Living Engaged, with Erem Latif.

After the sudden loss of her twenty-year-old son, host Missy Linkletter found herself facing a grief she never imagined. Through personal stories, conversations about the realities of grief, and biblical truth, she comes alongside you with practical help and reminders that God is near and faithful, even in the hardest days.


Whether your loss is recent or you’ve been carrying it for years, Dear Grieving Heart is a place to find comfort for today, hope for what lies ahead, and encouragement to keep walking with Christ one day at a time.

title: Scarface Minute
author: FS Studio
description:
Welcome to Scarface by the Minute, the podcast that breaks down Brian De Palma's 1983 crime epic one minute at a time.
Each episode zooms in on a single minute of the film: what's on screen, what happened behind the camera, and the real history that inspired it. From the 1980 Mariel boatlift to the cocaine-fueled Miami of the early 80s, we dig into the true stories behind Tony Montana's rise, along with the cast, the crew, and the craft that made Scarface a cultural icon.
Along the way, you'll hear recurring segments like Minute Myths, where we separate fact from legend; the Temper Tracker and Ruthlessness Meter, where we chart Tony's slow boil; a lightning round of facts and figures; and our official rating of every minute on the cocaine mountain scale.
Whether you've seen Scarface fifty times or you're watching it for the first time, pull up a chair. We've got about 170 minutes to get through.

description:
When Captain John Walker and his three siblings set sail on the Swallow, they embark on what they believe will be a simple summer adventure. But upon arriving at an uncharted island in the Lake District, they discover much more than just a camping spot. Here, they encounter the fierce Amazons—two daring sisters who claim the island as their own and are ready to defend their territory. Tension mounts as the children navigate the challenges of friendship, rivalry, and the quest for treasure hidden among the island's secrets.

As the stakes rise, the Walker siblings must outsmart the Amazons to secure their claim while learning valuable lessons about teamwork and bravery. Will they work together to uncover the mysteries of the island, or will their differences tear them apart?

In my 10‑minute recording, I talk about five cultural words from Cuban and Hispanic culture, which is the culture I grew up in and the one that shapes my identity. The purpose of my recording is to help listeners understand important parts of Cuban life, traditions, and everyday experiences — especially for people who may have never heard these words before. Each word represents something meaningful in Cuban culture and shows how culture continues to influence us in the 21st century.The five words I chose are:
  1. Ropa Vieja – a traditional Cuban dish that represents family, history, and the reality of food scarcity in Cuba.
  2. Pregonero – a street vendor who sings and performs while selling items, showing the musical and expressive spirit of Cuban culture.
  3. Café Cubano (colado) – strong Cuban coffee that symbolizes community, daily rituals, and cultural connection.
  4. Quinceañera – the celebration of a girl’s fifteenth birthday, marking her transition into womanhood through symbolic traditions.
  5. Language (Cuban Spanish) – the unique slang, rhythm, and expressions Cubans use, showing how language reflects identity and cultural diversity.
Throughout the recording, I explain each word as if the listener has never heard it before. I share stories, examples, and cultural meaning behind each one. My goal is to show how Cuban culture contributes to cultural literacy in America today, and how understanding different cultural traditions helps us connect with one another.

title: Cruising to Skating
author: Jordan Leibrant
description: In this podcast I'm going to teach skateboarding. I am also going over famous skaters, a few unspoken rules, and the best skateboard brands. Follow me on Spreaker to take your skateboarding to the next level.

title: Hallway Chat
author: Fraser Kelton & Nabeel Hyatt
description:
Fraser & Nabeel explore what it means to build great products in this new world of AI.

Two former founders, now VCs, have an off-the-cuff conversation with friends about the new AI products that are worth trying, emerging patterns, and how founders are navigating a world that’s changing every week. 

Fraser is the former Head of Product at OpenAI, where he managed the teams that shipped ChatGPT and DALL-E, and is now an investor at Spark Capital. Nabeel is a former founder and CEO, now an investor at Spark, and has served on the boards of Discord, Postmates, Cruise, Descript, and Adept. 

It's like your weekly dinner party on what's happening in artificial intelligence.

title: When Therapy Ends
author: Nadine Elsasser
description:
What if your healing journey was always meant to end?
If you’ve done the deep emotional work, the therapy, the inner reflection and the personal development, and you sense that what comes next isn’t more work, you’re in the right place.
I’m Nadine Elsasser, Mystic, writer, Transformative Coach and founder of the Soul Aligned Resonance methodology. I meet women at the threshold after the healing work is done, and walk alongside them into life after therapy.
Here, there’s nothing left to fix or heal. Instead, we explore the pause, integration and embodiment, returning to your Natural Way of Being, trusting your intuition and living from wholeness, with joy and wonder leading the way.
New PodShots of around five minutes arrive every weekday. One idea and one small practice, so you can feel something shift that same day.

description:
New sound, familiar places.


Hidden Jams is a monthly live music series based in Amsterdam. Every month, an upcoming artist takes over a neighbourhood café or small theatre for an intimate pop-up concert. title: The Longevity Protocol
author: Dr John A. Robinson
description:
The Longevity Protocol podcast, hosted by holistic medical experts Dr. Cristina Romero-Bosch and Dr. John A. Robinson explores the art and science of living the well-lived life.

Drawing on decades of clinical experience, Dr. Bosch and Dr. Robinson go beyond conventional conversations about longevity. Together, they explore hormone optimization, regenerative medicine, sexual health, metabolic and cognitive performance, emerging longevity science, relationships, purpose, lifestyle, and the many factors that shape not simply how long we live—but how well we live.

As founders of The Hormone Zone and leaders in advanced integrative and longevity medicine, they bring a uniquely personal and clinical perspective to each conversation, blending science, experience, curiosity, and the practical lessons they have learned from caring for patients—and from their own pursuit of a well-lived life.

The Longevity Protocol: The Art and Science of Living the Well-Lived Life.

title: Almost Flowing
author: Flow Club
description:
Almost Flowing is a podcast for anyone who has ever felt stuck, overwhelmed, or unsure of how to move forward. We often picture success as a straight, linear path, but in reality, it is a messy journey filled with twists, turns, and setbacks. This podcast is about embracing that process and figuring out how to move from here to there.
In each episode, we talk to inspiring individuals from the Flow Club community and beyond, exploring how they navigate challenges, build momentum, and find their flow. We uncover habits, insights, and lessons to help you turn intention into action.

title: Mask'd Confessional
author: AIDS United
description:
Mask’d Confessionals is a podcast by and for Black gay men, creating space for candid conversations about HIV, sex, pleasure, chemsex, substance use, loneliness, relationships, bodily autonomy, and community care.


Hosted by Bishar Jenkins and Micah Marquez, the series explores the realities of Black gay men’s lives without reducing our experiences to risk, stigma, or pathology. These are honest conversations about desire, connection, survival, agency, and the things we do not always get to say out loud.


Produced by AIDS United as part of the Pipeline Collaborative, Mask’d Confessionals invites Black gay men to take the masks off, speak freely, and be fully seen.


New episodes release October 14, October 28, and November 11, 2026.

title: Wincinnati Podcast
author: Wincinnati
description: Are you looking for one of the best Cincinnati Bengals podcasts? Join Ace Boogie and Zim Who Dey as they analyze everything about the Cincinnati Bengals on the Wincinnati podcast. If you are a diehard Bengals fan looking for Cincinnati Bengals news, insight, rumors, information, and excitement, this show is for you.

title: The Red Room
author: Voyage Media
description:
From the same team that brought you the #1 hit fiction podcast Elucidity.

When a voicemail pulls podcaster Jordan Purcell and producer Lynn McCready into the cold case disappearance of a teenage girl, they see it as a salacious story for clicks. The trail leads through fragments of an Asian urban legend that refuses to stay contained, echoing across witnesses, recordings, and places that shouldn’t be connected. As their podcast gains traction, so do the threats from those who want the past buried and from something that may not belong to the past at all. What they uncover isn’t just a missing person, but something few only whisper about as "The Red Room"... a pattern that fractures their minds and comes for them next.

title: One voice at a time
author: Aidóni
description:
What does journalism actually do to people? How does it shape societies, influence wars, and affect the lives of communities in crisis and conflict?
One Voice at a Time is aidóni's monthly podcast: one-on-one conversations with people from communities whose stories are too often told without them, agents of change trying to make things better, researchers studying how narratives shape societies and vice versa, and journalists asking harder questions about what this work is actually for.
No easy answers. One voice at a time.

title: MASTER ORGANIZED MOTHERHOOD | Home Organization Strategies, Time Management Tips, Cleaning, Decluttering Tips
author: Amy Rust | Organization Systems Strategist Coach
description:
** TOP 3% GLOBALLY RANKED PODCAST **
Do you feel like you are drowning in clutter? 
Are you embarrassed by how your home looks and avoiding inviting others over because it would take a day and a half to clean, leaving you feeling too exhausted to host when the guests finally arrive?
Do you want an organized life but don’t know where to start, or if you did start, wouldn’t know how to stay consistent?
Friend! There is an easier way…and a better way to organize your home and life that doesn’t require it to be Pinterest perfect. 
This podcast will help you create peace in your home with less clutter, easier systems, more routines, and the consistency to stay organized.
Hey, I’m Amy. Wife, chaos coordinator and work-from-home mom of 4 kids 6 and under.  For years, I thought that an organized home meant perfectly clean, and pinterest perfect at ALL times.
I spent all my time cleaning, and relocating everyone’s belongings, trying to maintain a sense of visual peace in my home. I felt like I could not get any work done until the house was picked up and put away. Feeling frustrated with my family for the messes they had created were a daily occurrence. I tried every tip for cleaning, organizing and managing my home, only to fall off track again and feel like a failure… I let my home dictate how successful & productive I felt, only to end up more stressed out & overwhelmed. I was struggling to find the joy in motherhood, while losing myself in the never ending organizational process.
Finally, I came to realize that in order to become the happy, organized Mom I wanted to be, I had to live each day with purpose and intention, that stemmed from the ideal home atmosphere I wanted to create for my family.
So, I developed a simple framework that focuses on organization as the WHOLE picture. Creating sustainable habits, goals and systems that finally created the consistency I could actually attain. I am so excited to share it with you!
If you are ready to finally create a home with that peaceful atmosphere you desire - One that is organized, and clutter free. With simple systems to help you stay consistent so you can spend more intentional time with those babies you are raising and less time managing the over-flowing stuff, then this is the podcast for you!
Brew some coffee, pack up the kids for a car nap and let’s go my friend, it’s your turn to learn!

title: Faerie Fire
author: Dan Jeffs
description:
Create your own perfect player character (you) in the most important adventure of all (life).
Each week I find the best, brightest and most brilliant in the Dungeons & Dragons community. Artists, artisans, Dungeon Masters, players, musicians, creators, designers and much much more. 
It's my job to find out their best tips, tricks, tools and tactics that you can use to build your own perfect player character.
Business, fitness, mental health, design, DM tips, creating, crafting. 
Everything is here.

Tiffany Richey is the owner of Richey Wellness, where she has helped people take a more intentional approach to their health and well-being. On Live, Actually… she brings that same perspective to honest conversations about health, purpose, relationships, resilience, and the choices that shape how we live. Through real stories, expert insight, and practical takeaways, each episode helps you cut through the noise, reconnect with what matters, and create a life that feels as good as it looks.

title: The Canberra Playbook Podcast
author: POLITICO
description: POLITICO’s early morning guide to what’s driving Australian politics — and why it matters. The Canberra Playbook Podcast is hosted by Amanda Copp. Each 15-minute episode Monday, Wednesday and Friday, brings listeners two conversations: a political interview that goes beyond the soundbites, and a conversation with a journalist from POLITICO's global newsroom. Together, we’ll take you behind the scenes of Australia’s power shifts and how these moves connect Australia to the U.S., Europe and the world. Clear, conversational and grounded in reporting, the Canberra Playbook Podcast brings you the people and context behind the day’s biggest stories.

description: ead End is dedicated to original, in-depth true crime documentaries that focus on cases where choices, actions, and consequences collide. Each video is independently researched, written, and produced from the ground up — built around verified facts, timelines, and critical turning points. Every case is approached as a standalone investigation, designed to break down what happened, how it unfolded, and why it reached a dead end.

description: The Podcast Growth Blueprint is a practical podcast for creators, entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and business owners who want to grow their podcasts and build loyal audiences. description:
Welcome to the Lucia Acoustic Sessions!
These sessions are designed as a warm, listening‑focused space for emerging and aspiring acoustic performers. Each month we feature a small group of artists, along with a guest performer who shares insights about their craft. It’s a relaxed but curated environment where musicians can connect with one another and share meaningful work. The goal is to create a warm, attentive space where performers can engage with each other and you (the audience)—your presence helps set that tone.
We truly appreciate your being part of this community.

Matt Casamassina, former editor-in-chief IGN64, IGNcube.

description:
Embodied and Emboldened is a safe, sacred space grounded in the intelligence of the body and the powerful revolution of no longer performing, hiding or seeking permission to earn love, belonging, or acceptance.
Hosted by Briana Wyatt, professor, priestess, and coach, this podcast weaves leadership, spirituality, embodiment and lived experience through reverent attention to the nervous system, the inner life, and the wisdom that emerges when we stop forcing.
This exploration is not about becoming someone better. It is about becoming the most authentic, highest expression of yourself.

description: Welcome to The Modern Success Podcast—your guide to becoming more confident, capable, and successful in today’s fast-changing world.Each episode explores the ideas, strategies, and skills that can help you grow your career, communicate with confidence, develop leadership skills, negotiate effectively, build professional relationships, and achieve your goals.From business and workplace communication to personal development, productivity, mindset, and modern leadership, we break down practical lessons you can apply in your professional and personal life.Whether you're an ambitious professional, entrepreneur, manager, student, or simply someone committed to continuous growth, The Modern Success Podcast gives you practical insights to help you think better, communicate better, and move forward with purpose.Learn. Grow. Communicate. Lead. Succeed.

description: Real cases. Real footage. The truth as the record tells it. Every case is sourced from authoritative materials and presented for educational and journalistic purposes. New investigations regularly. Subscribe and watch the truth unfold.

description: Are you an entrepreneur striving to create a business your customers love while building a life that truly supports your health, happiness, and loved ones? You'll hear insights on balancing success with well-being, nurturing meaningful relationships, and living life on your own terms. If you're ready to build a business and life you love, this is the podcast for you.

New episodes every week.
Welcome to the Seattle Sports Dad Cast.

Sleepy Nights is a calming podcast designed to help listeners of all ages slow down, settle their minds, and ease into sleep.
Each episode offers a gentle mix of guided imagery, relaxing stories, breathing exercises, body relaxation, mindfulness, and soothing reflections. Some nights may take you somewhere peaceful through imagination. Others may help quiet racing thoughts, release the stresses of the day, or simply give your mind something soft and comforting to follow as you drift off.
Get comfortable, turn down the lights, close your eyes, and let the day fade away.

That means doing things a little differently: prioritizing relationships and community in a radically individualist culture and embracing a soft, intentional lifestyle in a distracted world. Drawing from behavioral science, timeless role models (including Diana, of course), and communal wisdom, we’re building a life full of love, inspiration, and abundance - the one your true self has always been dreaming of.

title: Dreamy Dare with Hair Care

description: In this podcast, I will talk about how to style your hair any type of way you want.  I will also talk about how to take care of different hair types and how to style them. title: Something Needs To Change
author: Elizabeth Oakley
description:
Did you say yes when you wanted to say no? Or leave a conversation wishing you’d said what you really meant?
*Something Needs to Change* is for women over 40 who recognise moments like these but aren’t sure how to start changing them. I’m Liz Oakley, a Transformation Mentor, and I’ll talk with you about the everyday situations that affect how you feel, speak and make choices.
These are short, honest Pod Shots. I’ll bring you one situation, another way to look at it and a question that helps you hear what you think.
Expect bite sized solo episodes, with new Pod Shots shared regularly.

title: Pop This!

Andrea Gin is a producer and avid figure skating fan. Every week they talk about things they love, stuff that pisses them off, and pop culture: movies new and old, TV, books, music, and more. description: Whispers of Love: A Romantic EscapadeWelcome to Whispers of Love, your dedicated haven for all things romance, connection, and deep emotional bonds. In each episode, we dive into captivating stories, heart-to-heart conversations, and inspiring reflections about love in all its forms—from passionate courtships to enduring partnerships.Whether you are looking for relationship insights, cozy romantic tales, or simply a warm space to celebrate love, join us as we explore the beauty of human connections. Tune in, relax, and let your heart be inspired!

title: Don't Call Me Darlin'
author: Carolyn Kendrick & Tristan Scroggins
description:
Before social media, the women of bluegrass had a bright blue newsletter that showed up in the mailbox and said what no one would say out loud. In Don't Call Me Darlin', host Carolyn Kendrick and co-creator Tristan Scroggins hit the road to find the women Murphy Henry profiled decades ago, in a story about genre, identity, feminism, and the communities we built before the internet.
What can our foremothers teach us about how to challenge the system? And when should we challenge our own expectations? In conversations with legends such as Alice Gerrard, Kristin Scott Benson, Laurie Lewis, Missy Raines, Alison Brown, Rhonda Vincent, Sierra Hull, Bronwyn Keith-Hynes, and many more, our hosts learn how tradition can bring community together and how it can break it apart. On this road trip, Bluegrass music becomes an unlikely catalyst for exploring the paradoxical world of bluegrass, an American art form with American problems, strengths, and growing pains. Don't Call Me Darlin' is distributed by The Bluegrass Situation Podcast Network.

title: Build Your Wealth
author: Josh Marsden
description:
Building wealth shouldn't require a finance degree or access to an exclusive network.
On Build Your Wealth, Josh Marsden sits down with accomplished entrepreneurs, investors, and financial thinkers to make their best ideas understandable and useful. Each conversation breaks down real experiences, proven principles, and practical strategies that everyday people can use to improve their financial decisions and move toward greater freedom.

Strategy. Growth.*

title: Window on the Word
author: Port Nelson United Church
description: Welcome to Window on the Word: A podcast from Port Nelson United Church in Burlington, Ontario.  In this series, we seek to shine contemporary light on ancient words.  Windows of understanding are opened on biblical stories as we listen for words of hope, grace and love for daily life in this world. We hope that these words encourage and nurture your spiritual journey.

title: The Disappearing Spoon: a science history podcast with Sam Kean
author: Sam Kean
description: A topsy-turvy science-y history podcast by Sam Kean. I examine overlooked stories from our past: the dental superiority of hunter-gatherers, the crooked Nazis who saved thousands of American lives, the American immigrants who developed the most successful cancer screening tool in history, the sex lives of dinosaurs, and much, much more. These are charming little tales that never made the history books, but these small moments can be surprisingly powerful. These are the cases where history gets inverted, where the footnote becomes the real story.

title: The No More Wasted Days Podcast
author: Sara Kaufman-Bradstreet
description:
This is the No More Wasted Days Podcast. I'm your host - Sara Kaufman-Bradstreet.

Grab your favorite NA drink, and listen as we share vulnerable stories so you never feel alone on your alcohol free journey, and gain insights from us as we breakdown our most used tips and strategies that have kept us alcohol free. title: The Grounded Presence Podcast
author: Matt Emhoff
description: Life can leave us exhausted, overwhelmed, stuck, and confused. The Grounded Presence Podcast offers honest, relaxed conversations about navigating the chaos of everyday life. It isn’t about having all the answers—it’s about learning together and remembering that we’re not alone.

title: Build, Fund, Scale, Exit with Ken Lee

Build, Fund, Scale, Exit is a practical, founder-to-founder conversation with the people building innovative businesses, products and technology.

Host Ken Lee, founder of MBX Ventures, has spent more than two decades building, funding and commercialising businesses, including two IPOs and two nine-figure exits. Each episode goes beyond the polished founder story to explore what people are actually building, the technical and commercial challenges they are working through, how they are funding growth, and what they need to reach the next stage.

Expect candid conversations about validation, product development, customers, capital, R&D, growth and the decisions founders make along the way - including what worked, what didn’t and what they would do differently.

Drawing on conversations with founders, operators, distributors, and brand builders in the drinks trade, Chris looks beyond the official story to uncover the small signals and real-world forces behind what works. Each episode asks what business leaders in any category can learn from what actually happened.
No universal playbooks. Just grounded observations, sharper questions and practical lessons that travel beyond drinks.

description: A top 2% globally ranked podcast about what it takes to build in business, leadership, and life.Tenacity is the discipline to keep building when the path is unclear, refusing to let fear, pressure, or uncertainty make your decisions for you.Every conversation digs into the pivots, failures, restarts, and the growth that came from them. Guests share what happened when things fell apart, what they did next, and what they learned the hard way, with actionable takeaways founders can apply to shape long-term success.Our guests are founders and leaders who have built and rebuilt after failure, started over after major life disruption, or built success in rooms not built for them.Hosted by Sonia Couto, a Toronto-based tech founder who has been starting over her whole life, rebuilding failed products, leading three companies through a breast cancer diagnosis, and turning every restart into something stronger.New episodes weekly. From housing and water to childcare and economic diversification, host Annabelle Homer speaks with people on the ground about what’s standing in the way of regional growth and what can be done about it.

title: Audioguide to the Zacharovanyi Krai National Park in the Kamyanka tract
author: Greenways Ukraine
description:
Welcome to Zacharovanyi Krai National Nature Park. The park protects unique natural heritage, including ancient volcanic landscapes, UNESCO-listed primeval beech forests, the rock formations of the Zacharovanyi Krai Geological Reserve, the high-altitude Black Bog, mountain streams and waterfalls, and rare plants and wildlife.
 
This audio guide will take you through the Kamianka Valley and help you discover more about the park’s nature along the way. The route is an easy 11 km hike that takes around 4 hours and includes 11 themed stops .

We'll look at theories and questions about this weird underground world.

Making the Stan is a celebration of 20 years of Danity Kane—the music, the memories, the drama and the impact of one of the most iconic girl groups of the 2000s.
Hosted by Ryan, a devoted Stan, and his friend Steve, a self-proclaimed newbie when it comes to the world of DK, this podcast takes a deep dive into the history of Danity Kane, from their formation on Making the Band 3 to their chart-topping success, unforgettable performances, lineup changes, reunions, and lasting influence on pop and R&B culture.

Behind the worn hoodie, he hides a fortune built from stolen mafia money and a shadowy whisper network. He believes taking from thieves is justice — until he falls for Sienna Vale, the bankrupt mafia princess whose family his fortune may have destroyed.
Every episode: a whisper, a secret move, a mafia consequence, a cliffhanger.
▶ Follow for weekly episodes.

title: Have Fun Socal
author: Paul Benevich
description:
Have Fun SoCal is your guide to memorable places, experiences and adventures across Southern California and beyond.


Join Paul Benevich as he explores beaches, concerts, local events, neighborhood restaurants, scenic hikes, water adventures, hidden gems and weekend escapes. Each episode combines a real story with useful information to help you decide where to go, what to expect and how to make the most of the experience.


Because it’s not just about where you go—it’s about the moments you find along the way. Sometimes the best memories begin with something close to home: taking the drive, buying the ticket, trying a new restaurant or finally visiting that place you’ve passed a hundred times.


Southern California is where we begin. Then we’ll follow the coast and see where the next adventure takes us.


For related articles, helpful links and more information about every experience, visit HaveFunSoCal.com.


Your next favorite memory might be closer than you think. Let’s go find it.

title: Dead Drop
author: Sami
description:
Dead Drop tells the true stories of espionage. Each episode, host Nirob takes one real spy story — the Cambridge Five at the heart of British intelligence, the atomic spies who gave Moscow the bomb, a colonel who quietly prevented a nuclear war, a dead man who fooled the Nazis, a family that sold its country's naval secrets — and rebuilds it: the era, the people and their motives, the secrets they stole or protected, the moment of betrayal, and the discovery that brought it all down.

From the Dreyfus Affair that split France to the Venona codebreakers who exposed the Soviet networks, from the great Cold War moles to the modern illegals, Dead Drop is about loyalty and betrayal, ideology and greed, and the quiet, invisible war that has run beneath the visible one for a century. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what remains disputed, and clear about the human cost on every side. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new betrayal every week

title: Cosmic Cold Cases

description:
The universe is full of unsolved cases.

A radio signal that lasted 72 seconds and never came back. An object that arrived from another star system and left before we could understand it. Spacecraft that vanished without a word.

Cosmic Cold Cases reopens these files, one mystery per episode. We follow the clues, meet the people who found them, weigh the competing explanations, and ask what we still do not know. No equations, no jargon, no homework. Just real stories from space, told in about 20 to 30 minutes.

If you love true crime, unexplained mysteries, or you simply look up at the night sky and wonder what is out there, this show is for you.

New episodes regularly. Subscribe so you do not miss the next case.

title: Grace on Her Plate with Melanie Schmitt
author: Melanie Schmitt
description:
Grace on Her Plate is the Christian weight-loss podcast for women who have significant weight to lose, are tired of starting over, and know their weight is keeping them from fully living out their God-given purpose.
Hosted by Melanie Schmitt, this show goes far beyond calories, meal plans, and temporary motivation. Melanie has spent thousands of dollars chasing answers. She has tried diets, pills, shakes, shots, fasting, fitness programs, hypnosis, keto, bariatric surgery, and nearly every promise the weight-loss industry could sell her.
She has weighed more than 300 pounds and as little as 112 pounds—and experienced nearly every number in between. She also understands the physical pain, embarrassment, isolation, shame, and defeated mindset that can come when your body gets larger and your life begins to feel smaller.
Three years ago, Melanie finally declared, “That was my last fat Christmas.”
Instead of trying another quick fix, she applied her own coaching process to her health, created Purpose Driven Health and Healing, and became her own favorite student. Using her six-step DESIGN process, she lost 90 pounds, strengthened her relationship with God, and gained clarity around her highest Kingdom calling.
Each week, Grace on Her Plate brings raw conversations, biblical truth, practical coaching, and real strategies around food, fitness, mindset, self-worth, emotional eating, lasting weight loss, and spiritual transformation.
This is not a podcast for the woman trying to lose five vanity pounds. It is for the woman whose health, confidence, independence, relationships, and calling have been limited by her weight.
You are not too far gone. You have not failed God. And you do not have to transform your life through shame, punishment, or another temporary diet.
It is time to put grace on your plate, purpose back into your health, and become the woman God designed you to be.

author: S. A. Vale
description:
He had one rule...never drink what you didn't pour. Then a priestess walked into his tent for a goddess's stolen veil, took off her silver crescents one by one...and stayed until dawn. When she left, the mark on his wrist had gone dark. In Carthage, even pleasure keeps a ledger.

NIGHTFORGE AFTER DARK is the companion show to The Carthage Cycle...grimdark historical fantasy set in the real Truceless War of 240 BC, when the richest city on earth refused to pay its own army. 


Lore by firelight, myths of the two temples, readings from the dark. 


The books live in Kindle Unlimited. The world you seek lives here.

🛡️ Read every book free before the world does: nightforgeafterdark.com/gatekeepers

18+. Epic worlds. Dangerous desire. Mind the dark.

title: The Book of Mormon: An Unabridged Narration (10 Minute Edition)
author: Amulek Audio and Taylor Seth Hall
description: This audiobook series seeks to tell the unabridged saga "The Book of Mormon" in a way that is engaging, compelling, and reverent. The primary goal of this podcast is to increase listener comprehension of the book as a whole: of its stories and its doctrines, as well as the larger theological arguments of its writers.

title: Inspirations for a Better Life
author: Phill
description: Inspirational stories from a wide range of individuals together with solo episodes of Phill Hanlon using his Trademarked methodology of the Hanlon Method which is steeped in NLP, Havening, Time-line Therapy and Hypnotherapy alongside a massive dose of Personal Development compiled over 30 years of expereince.

title: Attempted Intelligence
author: KnowBe4
description: Attempted Intelligence is a weekly conversation for people who are using AI. Not the researchers building it, and not the news cycle chasing it, but the marketers, product managers, engineers, and curious executives figuring out how to apply it to real work. Hosted by Harlan Parrott, VP of AI Innovation, and Matthew Duren, SVP of Engineering, AI & Data, both at KnowBe4, each episode opens with where AI is moving the needle on a given theme, then brings in a practitioner to walk through how they applied it: what they tried, what broke, what it was worth. You don't have to be an AI expert to watch. That's exactly who it's for.

title: Dr. MCB’s Curiosities
author: Dr. Marie Claire Bourque
description:
What are you curious about?

I'm Dr. Marie Claire Bourque, Dr. MCB. I'm a psychiatrist, and I ask a lot of questions. My favourite ones are the ones I don't know the answers to.

That's where Dr. MCB’s Curiosities starts. We take a question about neuroscience, human behaviour, clinical medicine, or something else entirely, and build a podcast episode or series to explore the answer.

I read the research and look at different explanations. What do we know? How do we know it? And what haven't we figured out yet?

You get to follow that search with me, without having to work through all the papers yourself. We'll make sense of the science in plain language, including where the evidence is uncertain or the answer is still taking shape.

You might leave with a clearer answer, a different understanding of something you thought you knew, or another question worth asking.

And if you've got a question I can't answer, send it my way. That's the engine.

Dr. MCB’s Curiosities is produced by PIPACO Tech. Dr. MCB is a Clinical Instructor at the University of British Columbia and a Clinical Assistant Professor at the University of Calgary's Cumming School of Medicine. The views expressed are her own and are not endorsed by either university. This podcast is general education, not medical advice, and does not create a doctor–patient relationship.

title: That Black Girl
author: Eberechi
description:
That Black Girl is a space for conversations about faith, womanhood, books, history, health, culture, and everyday life.
Rooted in Scripture and grounded in the realities of modern womanhood, we explore what it means to live, learn, grow, and navigate the world as women of faith. From Christian femininity and relationships to health, literature, history, culture, childhood, adolescence, and young adulthood, That Black Girl makes room for thoughtful conversations about the things that shape who we are.
Unapologetically His. 
Unashamedly her. 
Embracing Christian femininity.

title: Back In Service
author: Ka'ohu Seto
description:
Back in Service, hosted by longtime Oʻahu paramedic Kaʻohu Seto, shares the real stories behind the uniform—from the calls that stay with you and the moments that make you laugh to family, retirement, finances, and life after service.
Hear honest conversations with first responders, their families, and the people who understand what it means to serve.
Real stories. Real conversations. Life beyond the uniform.

title: Amplify You - The Weekly Signal
author: Daily Mindset Moments
description: Amplify You: The Weekly Signal is a practical weekly podcast for founders, creators and small businesses who want to earn more attention on LinkedIn and social media. Each episode cuts through the noise to unpack the digital marketing shifts, platform updates and AI developments that matter most and then turns them into clear, useful actions you can apply to your content that week.

title: Risex Documentaries
author: Risex Documentaries
description:
🎙️ TRUE CRIME & MYSTERIES

Real cases. Hidden details. Unanswered questions.

Explore fascinating true crime stories, mysterious disappearances, unsolved cases, investigations, and events that continue to raise questions.

Each episode takes you through the timeline, evidence, theories, and unexpected details behind cases that captured public attention.

🔎 Some cases have answers. Others remain mysteries.

Follow the podcast and discover the stories behind the headlines — one case at a time.

title: Honest To God Podcast
author: Zoe Willis
description: A Hollywood makeup artist and an English homeschooling mum of six walk into a podcast…  Felicia Linsky and Zoë Willis live in very different worlds. They have big opinions, very little interest in polite small talk, and an alarming willingness to discuss the things everyone else is thinking but perhaps knows better than to say out loud.  From motherhood, marriage and menopause to ageing, beauty, family, faith, culture, the-youth-of-today and whatever on earth has annoyed them this week, Honest to God is two friends comparing notes on life from opposite sides of the Atlantic...and occasionally opposite sides of an argument.  Expect honest conversation, unexpected rabbit holes, disagreements, inappropriate laughter and probably some swearing. Nobody is pretending to have all the answers.  Just the sort of conversations that usually happen when everyone sensible has left the room.  Honest to God. Because apparently nothing is sacred.

title: Death Care Today
author: Rob Goff
description: "Welcome to Death Care Today—the show where we bring light, clarity, and compassion to the topics we rarely talk about, but all eventually face.

title: The View From Here with Jared Sinclair
author: Jared Sinclair
description:
The View From Here with Jared Sinclair brings you face to face with fascinating, intelligent, and successful people. Founders, leaders, experts, and thinkers who've climbed high enough, researched deep enough, and experienced enough to see and understand things the rest of us might miss. We sit down for real, unscripted conversations about how they think, what they've learned, and the hard won perspective behind their knowledge and success. Every episode hands you a front row seat to perspective, ideas, and knowledge you won't find anywhere else, the kind of insight that shifts how you think, sharpens how you make decisions, and gives you an edge most people never get. 
No filters, no fluff, just candid conversations with people worth listening to.

title: InFocus Podcast - Phylip Morgan
author: Focus Technology Europe Ltd
description:
We're excited to launch the very first episode of InFocus, the new podcast from Focus Technology Europe, where we explore the topics shaping the future of business, technology and innovation.

For our debut episode, Focus Technology Europe CEO Andrew Davenport sits down with Phylip Morgan of Pax8 for a thought-provoking discussion on the challenges and opportunities facing organisations in today's rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Together, they explore:

 ✅ The current business and economic landscape

 ✅ How organisations can use technology to drive growth and profitability

 ✅ The real opportunities and practical applications of AI

 ✅ The risks of Shadow AI and the importance of governance

 ✅ Balancing security, productivity and innovation

 ✅ What separates digitally successful businesses from those being left behind

 ✅ The technology trends that will define the next few years

Whether you're a business owner, senior leader, technology professional or simply curious about how AI and emerging technologies are transforming the world of work, this episode is packed with insights, practical advice and forward-looking perspectives.

This is just the beginning for InFocus, and we can't think of a better first guest than Phylip to help unpack what modern businesses need to know to stay competitive in an increasingly technology-driven world.

title: Emily Knight: Private Eye
author: evalyski
description:
Emily Knight is a young private investigator, quick and sharp and good at what she does. She takes cases for the right reasons, even when the people asking can't always pay.

Every episode is one self-contained case, about thirty minutes long. A ring goes missing at a charity gala. A simple favor turns out not to be simple. A room full of polite people each has something to hide. It's light on the jokes and serious about the puzzle, and the clues are in the story if you're listening closely. Start with any episode.

Every voice in this show is AI-generated, including Emily's. The story map behind each case is designed by a human.

title: The A-List with Andrea Logan
author: Andrea Logan
description: The A-List with Andrea Logan is where faith meets ambition —unfiltered conversations about reinvention, wellness, relationships, entrepreneurship, Hollywood, and what it really takes to build an extraordinary life without losing yourself in the process. Hosted by actress, author, entrepreneur, producer and mom of three Andrea Logan, the show goes beyond the highlight reel with inspiring guests and honest stories about failure, comeback, purpose, identity, and discovering that God’s A-List often looks very different from the world’s.

title: The GYM session
author: Charlie Copsey &  Fleur East
description:
Welcome to The GYM Session!


It’s Fleur East and Charlie Copsey here, founders of Grow Your Movement, the community platform for women to learn, connect and grow


Join us for weekly episodes where we bring you along the journey as we build our platform and community. 

This is where we have honest conversation about our experiences in real time. 

Our personal bests, our biggest challenges, our fears, failures and small wins, nothing is off limits. 


But that’s not all! 


We will also have weekly FLEX sessions. Providing weekly bitesize episodes with our PTs (experts) across finance, fitness, health, mindset and communication and career. These will provide you with expert knowledge and practical tips that you can put into action straight away. 


Now, let's get to work.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Her Again Podcast
author: Julie Ha
description:
You’ve spent so much time being who everyone else needed that somewhere along the way, you stopped recognizing yourself. HER AGAIN is for the woman ready to break unhealthy patterns, rebuild her self-worth, and create deeper relationships without losing herself inside them. 
Hosted by relationship and mindset coach Julie Ha, each episode brings honest conversations, personal stories and practical tools to help you heal, trust yourself and become the woman you’re meant to be. You’re not starting over. You’re becoming HER AGAIN.

title: JesusHouse Podcast
author: JesusHouse
description:
JESUSHOUSE is a new church expression in Lancaster County PA, honoring the region’s legacy of faith and spirituality while stepping into what God is doing today.

Check here weekly for our sermon of the week.

title: The Doing Enough Podcast
author: Cesar Gamiz
description: The Doing Enough Podcast is hosted by Cesar. The podcast’s mission is to break through the systems and stigmas that prevent people from being their authentic selves by being audacious, identifying the root causes, and beginning to unlock their true potential through entertainment. While the podcast will cover self-reflection, it won’t stop there. Hot topics and current events in pop culture are always fun to talk about, but seeing them through an introspective lens will make it all worth listening to.

title: Torch Talks Life
author: Torch in the Fog
description: Real talk about real life from Torch in the Fog. Pressure, doubt, the grind, and the fire to walk through it all. New episodes regularly. Stay lit.

title: Be The Only
author: Subrat Sahoo
description:
BETHEONLY is a podcast about entrepreneurship, business, personal growth, innovation and the people building what’s next. Hosted by Subrat Sahoo, each episode features honest conversations with founders, entrepreneurs, coaches, executives, creators and leaders from around the world about their journey, ideas, challenges and lessons.
Discover new perspectives on building businesses, creating meaningful relationships, personal branding, leadership, technology and the future of work, through conversations designed to leave you with an idea worth remembering.

title: The Zach Martin Show
author: NEWHD Media
description: The Zach Martin Show is a production of IRHUB, heard on IRHUB Radio and across the NEWHD Radio and Veterans Classic Rock networks. Zach Martin brings the guests to the microphone: authors, entertainment figures, sports voices, movers and shakers, corporate leaders, and entrepreneurs. The conversation is direct. What they built, what it cost, and what they see coming. No scripted rundown. The story, in their own words. The show sits at the intersection of the networks Zach runs. IRHUB Radio is the broadcast voice of KMKT and the IRHUB investor ecosystem, where companies and investors meet on the air. NEWHD Radio is where rock lives. Veterans Classic Rock is America's Super Station, built for veterans and the classic-rock audience. The Zach Martin Show carries that same on-air standard across business, culture, sports, and the people moving both. A production of IRHUB, on NEWHD Radio and Veterans Classic Rock. New episodes on IRHUB Radio. Listen on Spreaker and everywhere you get podcasts.

title: Dr. Roni and Glaze: Whole Body Health and Redemption
author: Dr Roni and The Real Brian Glaze Gibbs
description:
Two powerful journeys come together for honest conversations about health, healing, redemption and transformation.
Dr. Roni, a respected holistic health expert with more than 30 years of experience, joins Brian “Glaze” Gibbs, a man who survived the streets, accepted responsibility for his past and chose a different purpose. Together, they explore what it truly takes to change your health, your thinking and the direction of your life.
Through real stories, practical wellness education and unfiltered conversations, Dr. Roni & Glaze confront the choices, habits and conditions that can destroy.

title: Why the Internet Works
author: Robby D.E.I, Dr. C and a Forman
description: Discourse of the people that created the history of technology in the last 200 years, and how it will shape our next 200 years.  The globe is in the middle of largest transformation since the dark ages.  As we transition from Capitalism to Connectivism, we need to rethink how to create a sustainable future with lessons from the past.

title: The Fantasy Frenzy
author: Brad Lowe
description: The Fantasy Frenzy | A Fantasy Football Podcast  Welcome to The Fantasy Frenzy, where fantasy football meets bold predictions, blockbuster trades, and a little bit of chaos!  Join Ashley and Sergio (aka the Lock City Mayor) as they break down everything happening in the world of fantasy football. From must-start players and waiver wire steals to sleeper picks, trade strategies, and players who just aren't living up to the hype, they've got you covered.  With Sergio's 18 years of fantasy football experience and Ashley's fresh perspective, expect passionate debates, hot takes, friendly trash talk, and plenty of laughs along the way.  Whether you're chasing a championship, fighting to stay out of last place, or just love football, The Fantasy Frenzy is your weekly dose of fantasy football madness.  New episodes every Wednesday on the Hopecast Network.

title: Famously Yourself
author: Audrey Elizabeth
description:
Famously Yourself is a podcast about the modern actor and performer, bringing conversations about everything that happens beyond the role.


Hosted by Audrey Elizabeth, a Public Presence Strategist with 20+ years in the performance industry, the podcast explores the psychology, identity, creativity and career strategy behind building a career as an actor today.


From star quality and being seen to self-tapes, social media, creating your own work, rejection, identity and public presence, we go beyond traditional acting advice to ask bigger questions about who actors are, how they’re perceived, and what becomes possible when they stop trying to fit the mould.


Expect conversations with actors, casting professionals, directors, creatives and industry voices- alongside Audrey’s own ideas, observations and frameworks from years spent on both sides of the stage.


Think bigger. 

Be more yourself.
This is Famously Yourself.

title: Ground Truth
author: Fervo Energy
description: Before Fervo Energy was a company, there was a flood in Houston, a Stanford class project, and a young engineer convinced fracking technology could crack geothermal energy wide open. Ground Truth traces Fervo’s decade-long climb from that grad-school hunch to a multibillion-dollar IPO, told not as corporate history, but as a human one. Host Olivia Johnson, new to the company herself, talks to the founders and early team about the years nobody believed them, the breakthrough in the Nevada desert, and what is expected to be the largest next-generation geothermal project on Earth rising in Utah.

title: The Streaming Club - What to Watch on Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video and More!
author: TVEngine.ai
description: The Streaming Club by TVEngine.ai helps you discover what to watch on Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video and other streaming platforms. Spend less time searching and more time watching. Each week, we break down what’s trending on Netflix, count down the movies and TV shows capturing everyone's attention, and uncover the stories behind the rankings. From breakout new releases to unexpected comebacks and long-running favorites, get a fast, entertaining look at what everyone’s watching and discover what you should watch next.

title: WTF Do My Friends Do?
author: Adam Heiman
description: After 5 years in Los Angeles’ creative industry, we’ve built a network of friends and colleagues across the entertainment world. On our podcast, we sit down with professionals across film & television, from studio executives to Hollywood actors, to talk about everything from the current state of the industry to the future of entertainment.

title: The Secret Lives of Artists
author: The Museum of Modern Art
description: An abstract artist who ran for mayor of New York. A public garden gatekeeper who painted her visions at night. An avant-garde composer who appeared on a game show as a mushroom expert. The Museum of Modern Art brings you a podcast telling the stories you don’t know about the artists you think you do. Each episode explores the secret talents and obsessive pursuits of some of our favorite modern artists. Hosted by MoMA content producer Naeem Douglas and featuring special guests, the podcast blends narration, interviews, and archival audio.

title: Under the Influence
author: BehaviourLAB Consulting
description:
Welcome to Under the Influence - the podcast that cuts through the corporate Bullsh*t and dives deep into what actually works when it comes to leadership, culture, and people at work. 

Hosted by Sam Walsham and Laura Bache, Co-founders of BehaviourLab Consulting.  We've spent years helping organisations turn fluffy culture promises into real, evidence-based change. Under the influence explores how most of what's trending on LinkedIn... doesn't stand up to scrutiny. 

 

From "quiet quitting" and generational stereotypes, to leadership buzzwords and culture hacks - this podcast unpacks the fads, questions the hype, and gives you the behavioural science behind the headlines. 


Each episode will break down one hot topic - what people are saying, what the research really shows, and what you can actually do about it in your team, your business, or your own career. 

So if you're under the influence of the latest people and culture trends - this podcast is your hangover cure. 


More science, less nonsense!


Music by Katie Chatburn

title: The School Of Ministry
author: Daniel & Rachel Emerson
description:
Founded by Daniel and Rachel Emerson, Overseers of Awakening To Revival Ministry. You'll discover this podcast as a new training center for your prophetic journey and ministry calling. 
Whether you're a new believer, a seasoned leader, or a kingdom entrepreneur, this is the podcast for you. We deliver spirit-filled teachings, releasing kingdom blueprints and strategies to raise up disciples who make disciples, churches that plant churches, and leaders who shape nations.

title: Okay So, What's Next? Podcast
author: with Parker Jackson
description:
Okay So, What’s Next? is a podcast about the moments that change everything, and the weird, exciting, uncertain part that comes after.
Hosted by actor Parker Jackson, each episode features honest conversations with actors, creators, founders, filmmakers, musicians, and people across entertainment and culture about ambition, identity, reinvention, risk, and what they’re actually building toward next.
Less about the polished success story. More about what happens next.
New Episodes Weekly.

title: Safety Stories: The Journey to Excellence
author: RoSPA
description: Hosted by Matt Cryer, Head of RoSPA Awards, each episode uncovers the stories, experiences and insights behind health and safety excellence.

title: Gater and Goose 713
author: Motor Trends of Houston
description: From Houston’s 713 to the world — Gater & Goose bring unfiltered conversations on automotive and entertainment industries, hustle, culture, and real life. No scripts. No filters. Just built-different energy.

title: 929 with Rabbi Dr. P. Rosenzweig
author: Rabbi Dr. P. Rosenzweig
description: torah with Rabbi Dr. P. Rosenzweig

title: The Winklings Book Club
author: Chris Knight
description: An exclusive literary society of exactly two members. Chris Knight is a distinguished philanthropist, wealthy industrialist, and man of impeccable taste. Micheal Lylez is a world-renowned etymologist whose mastery of classical texts is matched only by his precise, if occasionally alarming, interpretations. Each episode they review a great book with serious scholarship, confident conclusions, the occasional confession, and the distinct possibility that certain heroes were, in fact, large cats. Named in honor of the Inklings, and held to roughly the same standards.

title: Where was God?
author: Melissa Petersen
description: Where Was God? is a Christian podcast about real people, real stories, and real experiences with God. Hosted by Melissa Petersen, the show explores answered prayers, miracles, provision, healing, redemption, forgiveness, coming to faith, and moments when God moved in unexpected ways. We’ll also talk about loss, waiting, uncertainty, and seasons when God seemed absent. Through honest conversations, personal stories, and Scripture, we’ll ask: Where was God? Sometimes we see Him immediately. Sometimes we only see Him when we look back. And sometimes, God is still writing the story.

title: Reel Radar
author: Logan Smrek and Evan Sahli
description: Two longtime friends with a passion for cinema discuss anticipated releases in the movie world. In addition, they partake in fun movie related activities such as Top 10s, Drafts, challenges, etc.

title: For the Defense
author: forthedefense
description: For the Defense is a podcast dedicated to unraveling the complexities of the criminal justice system, particularly in Kansas. Hosted by Sean O'Connor, the show features in-depth conversations with experienced defense attorneys like Kevin Dellett, who share their insights on defending clients facing serious charges. The podcast aims to educate listeners on legal strategies, client rights, and the nuances of navigating the court system. Whether you're a legal professional, a defendant, or simply interested in criminal law, For the Defense offers valuable perspectives and practical advice.

title: The Duchess Diaries:  tales of romance and dramatic villains
author: The Duchess Diaries
description: Welcome to The Duchess Diaries! I love sharing tales of romance and dramatic villains. Subscribe for more and follow my socials!

title: crimson whispers Podcast
author: crimson whispers
description: Crimson Whispers Where every whisper hides a secret... and every secret has a price.  Step into the shadows with Crimson Whispers, a true crime podcast that unearths the chilling, the unsolved, and the stories that were never meant to be told. Each week, we peel back the layers of the world’s darkest mysteries—from twisted small-town secrets and forgotten cold cases to infamous killers and the haunting whispers left behind.  Whether you're drawn to the psychological depths of a criminal mind or the eerie coincidences that connect the dots, Crimson Whispers invites you to listen closely… becaus

title: Nameplate with Nat Bullard
author: Halycon
description: Interviews with the CEOs of the energy companies shaping the future of the United States. Hosted by Halcyon's Nat Bullard, this podcast will take you inside some of the brightest minds in an important industry the public rarely gets to hear from ... until now.

title: The First Nations Brief
author: Studio West
description:
The national conversation about First Nations peoples has been reduced to documents, targets and annual reports. Strategies get launched. Policies get announced. Plans get signed off. But too little changes in the lives of First Nations peoples, and too few organisations stop to ask why.


The First Nations Brief exists to ask why.


It's about strategy. Cultural intelligence. Policy development. Evaluation. Social policy. Reconciliation. And the social and political realities First Nations peoples live with every day, which decide whether any of it works.


Hosted by Dixie Crawford, founder of Nganya, the show is for the people who design, fund, deliver and measure decisions affecting First Nations peoples. That includes policy makers and public servants, executives and boards, strategy and evaluation professionals, not-for-profit and community sector leaders, reconciliation leads, researchers, and First Nations professionals and leaders.


Every episode is a brief: one question, the real problem behind it, and the social and political context that usually gets left out. Dixie then shares her take, drawn from over two decades across government, corporate and community settings, and what leaders can do differently.

title: The Way with Brian Davila
author: Brian Davila
description:
My name is Brian Davila. I am a 34 year old Christian with a wife and 5 kids. These are my core values: 

Be humble 
- Philippians 2:5–8 – “Have this mind among yourselves, which is yours in Christ Jesus, who… humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.”

Be the Best:
- 1 Corinthians 10:31 – “So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.”

Love others:
- John 13:34–35 – “A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another: just as I have loved you, you also are to love one another. By this all people will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

Business or speaking inquiries:
Briandavilarealestate@gmail.com


Reach out on Instagram @thebriandavila

title: The Good Vibe Check
author: JourneyWell Global LLC
description:
Turn off the notifications, pour a drink, and check in with us! The Good Vibes Check is the travel podcast dedicated to the beautiful chaos of group travel. Brought to you by Checked Bags & Good Vibes, we break down everything it takes to take group travel from concept to reality—without losing your mind (or your friends) in the process.
We dive deep into real travel stories, highlight practical group-planning strategies, and keep things light, funny, and relaxing. Whether you're planning a family getaway or a high-end vamping trip, we've got you covered.

title: The Floraux Radio
author: Alel Auxillos-Cayanan
description: TheFloraux Radio is a parent-led podcast helping families navigate the digital world. Hosted by lawyer and AI innovator AAC The Floraux, Doc-Dad Dr. Claro, 6-year-old Roblox expert John, fearless 4-year-old horror correspondent Blake, and AI co-host Scout, each episode explores gaming, AI, parenting, online safety, health, law, and technology. We answer four questions: What's happening? Why does it matter? Is it safe? What should families do next?

title: The Tech Universe
author: David Jones
description: The Tech Universe with David Jones is your ultimate gateway to modern technology, AI breakthroughs, and digital trends. Hosted by David Jones, this podcast delivers practical insights, expert analysis, and actionable tech knowledge in every episode.

title: Moon
author: Moon
description: Moon brings you captivating stories, unforgettable confessions, shocking experiences, and intriguing moments from the world of Reddit.Explore fascinating personal stories, relationship drama, mysterious encounters, scary experiences, unbelievable situations, and emotional confessions. Each episode takes you into a different story, filled with unexpected twists and moments that will keep you listening until the end.Whether you enjoy true-to-life experiences, Reddit confessions, dramatic stories, or mysterious encounters, Reddit Moon is your place to discover stories worth hearing.Follow the channel and enter the world of Reddit, one story at a time.

title: Atlanta Home & Property Report
author: ngapropertyjournal
description: Weekly conversations about homes and property across metro Atlanta, from Buckhead to Lawrenceville. Two hosts break down what local contractors are seeing on the job: custom builds, remodels, tree work, garage doors, and the upgrades homeowners ask about most. What works, what to expect, and how to choose the right crew. New episodes every week.

title: Victorious Living Solutions Podcast
author: Victorious Living Solutions Podcast
description: Victorious Living Solutions is a transformational coaching company that inspires and equips people to live VICTORIOUSLY, the way God intended for us to live! Our CEO, Dr. Nikeya Young, Ph.D., is a Board-Certified Mental Health Coach, Master Life Coach, Podcast Host, Best-Selling Author, Keynote Speaker, TEDx Speaker, and Ordained Minister. For more information, please visit our website at victoriouslivingsolutions.com!

title: Requested Reads
author: Requested Reads
description: Requested Reads brings you compelling stories, fascinating experiences, shocking confessions, and unforgettable moments inspired by the world of Reddit.From mysterious encounters and unbelievable real-life experiences to relationship stories, personal confessions, workplace drama, and unexpected twists, Requested Reads explores the posts and stories that keep people reading until the very end.Subscribe and discover new stories, surprising perspectives, and the most interesting corners of Reddit — one requested read at a time.

title: Jewish Law Made Simple
author: Rabbi Yisroel Shuchat
description: Jewish Law Made Simple is a class on the Abridged Code of Jewish Law (Kitzur Shulchan Aruch), taught in plain English by Rabbi Shuchat. Just a few minutes a day, and in one year you will have learned the entire book. No background needed.

title: Kickin’ it with Kunkel -- FULL EPISODES
author: Will Kunkel
description: Kickin’ it with Kunkel -- FULL EPISODES

title: Antarctica Calling
author: Simone Eringfeld
description:
Join expedition guide and sound recordist Simone Eringfeld on a sonic journey to Antarctica. Is "the silent continent" truly as silent as we think?
In this three-part audio adventure, you'll discover what happens when we deeply listen to Antarctica's melting soundscapes, above and beneath the ice. 
This podcast is part of Simone's PhD research at the Scott Polar Research Institute, University of Cambridge. For more information, visit www.simoneeringfeld.com

title: Elevate 216
author: Jamal & Jamaa
description: Jamaa Cox and Jamal Rogers team up to bring you Elevate 216. With diverse business backgrounds they bring unique perspective and experience earned information. From general business to financial literacy and real estate the goal of this podcast is not just to entertain but to service OUR community with information we typically are provided.

title: The Ophthalmology Playbook
author: Convert Health and ASOA
description: The Ophthalmology Playbook is a podcast for ophthalmology practice leaders. Each episode focuses on a topic that matters to running and growing a practice, with focused conversations about what’s working, what’s changing, and what leaders should be thinking about next.

title: Oltre il menù - Dietro le quinte della ristorazione
author: OnePodcast
description:
C'è un mondo di scelte che al ristorante finisce in un piatto, anche se come clienti non ce ne accorgiamo. Non è solo bravura ai fornelli, è un insieme di scelte silenziose ma rilevanti: far quadrare i conti, organizzare il servizio, guidare la squadra e gestire la pressione. La serie “Oltre il menù” svela ciò che accade dietro le quinte della ristorazione italiana, da Milano alla Sardegna passando per Roma. Ristoratori, imprenditrici, manager ed esperti affrontano le tendenze chiave e le sfide rilevanti del settore tra stagionalità, competenze, lavoro, imprese e consumatori.  
Una produzione METRO in collaborazione con Nevago

title: Different People Change the World Podcast
author: Jenson Day
description: Different People Change the World Podcast is a faith-based, inspirational podcast hosted by Jenson Day and a guest host. Each episode features conversations with guests from all walks of life as they share their unique stories, challenges, and the ways they are making a difference in the world.  Drawing from his own experiences with cerebral palsy, Jenson explores what it means to be different and how God can use our differences for a greater purpose. Through encouraging interviews and uplifting discussions, this podcast reminds listeners that different people really do change the world.

title: How It Ended
author: Kashcroe Gaming
description: How did gaming’s biggest names fall apart? How It Ended is a video game history podcast exploring the rise and fall of iconic franchises, consoles, and studios. Join Kashcroe for gaming documentaries tracing the breakthroughs, bad decisions, and turning points that shaped their fate. From beloved classics to ambitious failures, discover what went wrong, what survived, and why these stories still matter. Follow for retro gaming nostalgia and the stories behind the endings.

title: Let's Talk About It...
author: Dr. Aunjuli
description: Welcome to Let’s Talk About It..., an amnesty zone for the real, messy truths of life, resilience, and healing. Hosted by Dr. Aunjuli, this show moves past sanitized self-help and the pressure to "keep sweet" or stay quiet. Blending decades of mental health expertise with hard-won resilience, she unpacks trauma, toxic cultures, and reclaiming personal autonomy. If you are navigating environments that shrink you, recovering from upheaval, or learning to lay down the heavy armor of survival, you are not alone. Take a breath, stop hiding, and let’s talk about it.

title: The Later Life Podcast
author: 4TC Strategic Communication Consultancy
description: A Greater Life in Later Life. That's what this podcast is about. The Later Life Podcast talks to the people and digs into the topics that help over-60s get the most out of the years ahead: health, money, learning, travel, family, and the passions that motivate us most. It's practical and warm but never patronising. Come for the advice and stay for the stories.

title: Everyday Tools & Creative Ideas
author: kalsoom UK
description: Everyday Tools & Creative Ideas explores simple digital tools, learning activities, classroom resources, games, and creative techniques that can make everyday tasks easier and more engaging. Each episode looks at practical ideas that people can use for teaching, brainstorming, word games, writing exercises, group activities, and personal projects. From small browser-based utilities to clever ways of turning simple ideas into useful activities, the show focuses on accessible solutions that do not require complicated setups. Whether you're a teacher looking for a quick classroom activity, a writer searching for inspiration, or simply someone who enjoys discovering useful online resources, this podcast offers practical ideas worth trying.

author: Jen Meade
description: If you’ve ever stared at your phone wondering why he hasn’t texted, stayed for his potential, or felt like you had to earn love—this podcast is for you. I spent years thinking I had a man problem. I didn’t. I had a pattern. In Episode 1, I’m sharing what The Unchased Life means and how the 5 R’s—Reveal, Rewire, Regulate, Rebuild & Rehearse—help you finally stop repeating the same relationship and start choosing yourself.

title: Beneath the Decks
author: Beneath the Decks
description: Beneath the Decks is a cinematic interview and live-performance series for dance music artists. Each episode pairs a personal, unscripted conversation that is filmed at a location the artist chooses that is significant to them in some way with a full live DJ set shot in the same spot, fully curated by the artist. No PR spin, no scripted questions. Just the story beneath the sound, and the music that comes from it.

title: The Ardent Standard
author: Tracie Taylor
description: The Ardent Standard is for founders and business leaders who know something isn’t working, but the obvious problem may not be the real one. Expect practical, direct conversations that help you step out of the weeds, see your business more clearly, and focus on what actually needs to change.

title: The History of Funk Music Podcast
author: History Podcasts & Josh Linsk
description:
Explore the raw, rhythmic, and endlessly influential history of funk music. The History of Funk Music Podcast traces the singers, bands, bassists, producers, record labels, studios, cities, and cultural movements that transformed funk into one of the most important sounds in modern music.

Episodes journey from the gospel, soul, R&B, and jazz roots of funk through the groundbreaking work of James Brown, Sly and the Family Stone, Parliament-Funkadelic, The Meters, Ohio Players, Earth, Wind & Fire, and countless others. The show explores syncopated rhythms, bass-driven grooves, horn arrangements, studio experimentation, Afrofuturism, dance culture, fashion, live performance, regional scenes, record production, and the evolution of funk through the 1960s, 1970s, and beyond.

Whether you are fascinated by classic funk records, legendary bass lines, psychedelic funk, P-Funk, dance music, or the genre’s enormous influence on disco, hip-hop, R&B, rock, pop, and electronic music, the podcast tells the stories behind the artists, songs, scenes, and innovations that shaped the sound. The History of Funk Music Podcast is hosted by Josh Linsk.

title: We Witches 4
author: Christi, Mary Beth, Melissa and Christine
description: We Witches 4 is a podcast that explores the lives, experiences and stories of the four hostesses MaryBeth, Christi, Melissa and Christine. In our podcast we will explore what it is like being a witch in today’s society. We will be discussing a multitude of subjects including spells that we have used, our thoughts, beliefs on witchcraft and local lore from our place of residency in Bucks County, Pennsylvania. Enjoy the banter of this your four hostesses. Sit a spell for some hints and casting spells in the art of witchcraft. Listen to spooky tales from the area. Email us at Wewitches4@gmail.com

We’re excited to introduce The Voice of Hope Podcast, a space for meaningful conversations about faith, community, life, and the places where we discover hope, even in difficult seasons.
Hosted by Nancy Schmidt, each conversation invites us to listen, reflect, learn from one another, and explore a simple but important questions: What does hope mean to you? Where do you find hope? What if hope is not something you have to go out and find? What if hope's already searching for you?

description:
The Boobing Podcast - From breastfeeding disaster to exclusively boobing it. The Boobing Podcast is your zero-filter account of breastfeeding woes, triumphs, and more. I am your host, Melissa Wait, a mum who has been there and overcome just about every obstacle thrown at me while breastfeeding, I went onto breastfeed for almost two years. Every episode welcomes an expert to explain the medical and emotional nitty gritty of why things go wrong and what we can do about it. 88% of Australian mums face challenges breastfeeding – that is a crazy stat! The Boobing Podcast wants to normalise talking about and working through breastfeeding issues. If 88% of us are having trouble, we need real help, guidance, and sometimes a hug, laugh, or a shoulder to cry on!

title: The Whole Enchilada: Arnold Schwarzenegger and the Making of California's Historic Global Warming Law
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger and Joe Mathews; Read by Edoardo Ballerini
description: Twenty years ago, California Gov. Arnold Schwarzengger signed into law, Assembly Bill 32, officially named the Global Warming Solutions Act of 2006., it was the first law in the world to establish legally-binding reductions in greenhouse gas emissions across an entire economy.. But the law almost never passed. Drawing on documents that have never before been made public, "The Whole Enchilada" tells the improbable story of the making of a law that inspired a generation of environmental action around the world—and should inspire us to renew our efforts today.

title: Golf cart chronicles
author: whoisyourhero
description:
🎙️ GOLF CART CHRONICLES

What’s said after the swing.

Golf Cart Chronicles is a podcast recorded in a golf cart — over a round of golf — where real conversations unfold once the swing is over and the masks come off.

There’s no studio.
No scripts.
No pressure to perform.

Just two people sharing a cart, a few laughs, a few truths, and whatever comes out between the shots.

Some conversations are light.
Some go deep.
Some wander where they’re meant to.

This podcast isn’t about golf scores or swing tips.
It’s about life, resilience, pressure, purpose, mistakes, lessons, and the things men don’t always plan to talk about — but do, when the timing’s right.

Sometimes it’s 9 holes.
Sometimes it’s 18.
The conversation decides.

Hosted by Buzz, creator of Who Is Your Hero, Golf Cart Chronicles is for anyone who knows that the most important moments in life don’t happen on the scorecard — they happen after the swing.

⛳🎙️ If you’re up for a round and a real yarn, you’re already qualified.

description: Japanese OEM Insights takes a practical look at what it really takes to build relationships and win business with Japanese automotive OEMs. Hosted by Dan Zielinski, the podcast draws on more than 30 years of automotive manufacturing experience and years working directly with Japanese OEM engineering, purchasing and supplier organizations in North America and Japan. title: Ayekah: Finding Your True Self with Rav Shlomo Katz

Ayekah is a journey through Rav Reuven Sasson’s Be’or Panecha – Ayekah, exploring the Torah’s first great question to man: “Where are you?” 

Through the teachings of Rav Kook, Chassidut and the inner world of avodat hanefesh, Rav Shlomo Katz tries to understand what it means to live with greater authenticity, meaning and real freedom.

description: KIATWA is a space for women becoming. A space for growth, healing, reflection, and honest conversations about life as a woman today. Here, we challenge the narratives that limit women and explore what it truly means to become bold, whole and self-aware. Hosted by Aaisha Mabena, she aims to create a safe space for women to feel heard, seen and understood. KIATWA is mainly a healing space for women- womanhood is not a solo journey, it is walked together. If you are a woman becoming…you belong here. This is KIATWA!

title: Call Your Mom
author: Call Your Mom
description: What would you ask your mom if you could ask her anything? On **Call Your Mom**, 23 year old daughter Frances reads real letters from people looking for advice, and Ann—the mom—answers them. Maybe your relationship with your mom is complicated, maybe she's no longer around, or maybe the question is simply too awkward to ask her. Whatever the reason, you can ask us. title: The Fragrance Trade: Inside Perfume Oils
author: alfie martin
description:
The Fragrance Trade is an informative podcast exploring the world of perfume oils, fragrance sourcing, product development, wholesale distribution, and the evolving fragrance industry. Each episode examines how perfume oils are selected, evaluated, blended, packaged, and introduced to different markets, while offering practical insights for fragrance retailers, entrepreneurs, resellers, and enthusiasts.The series aims to make the business and creative sides of fragrance easier to understand. Topics can include fragrance profiles, oil-based perfumes, wholesale purchasing considerations, supplier relationships, quality evaluation, inventory planning, branding, customer preferences, and the role of regional fragrance markets.

For businesses researching sourcing opportunities, understanding the wholesale landscape can be an important part of building a sustainable fragrance operation. Resources such as perfume oil wholesale dubai can provide a useful starting point for exploring the broader subject of wholesale perfume oils and fragrance supply.Rather than focusing solely on selling products, the podcast will explain the principles behind successful fragrance sourcing and help listeners make more informed decisions about products, suppliers, positioning, and market opportunities.Series Objectives
  • Explain the fundamentals of perfume oils and fragrance products.
  • Explore how wholesale fragrance sourcing works.
  • Discuss important considerations when evaluating fragrance oils.
  • Help new fragrance businesses understand purchasing and inventory planning.
  • Examine changing consumer preferences in regional and international fragrance markets.
  • Discuss branding, packaging, retail presentation, and customer experience.
  • Provide educational conversations with fragrance professionals, retailers, entrepreneurs, and industry observers.
  • Connect traditional fragrance knowledge with modern business practices.
Suggested Episode Themes
  1. Understanding Perfume Oils: What Makes Them Different?
  2. How Wholesale Perfume Sourcing Works
  3. Dubai and the Global Fragrance Trade
  4. Choosing Fragrance Oils for a Retail Business
  5. From Fragrance Oil to Finished Product
  6. Understanding Fragrance Profiles and Customer Preferences
  7. Inventory Planning for Fragrance Retailers
  8. Building a Fragrance Brand From the Ground Up
  9. Packaging, Presentation, and the Customer Experience
  10. The Future of the Global Perfume Oil Market
